headline: Bank of England Hikes Interest Rates to 4% Amid Inflation Pressures
summary: The Bank of England raised interest rates to 4% in an effort to tackle surging prices driven by Iran war pressures, signaling further moves ahead.
why: Central bank policy rates dictate borrowing costs, influencing currency valuations, bond yields, and domestic economic activity.

impacts.name: Bank of England Base Rate
impacts.why: The central bank officially announced a rate hike to 4%.
